description: Aljal Public Data (알잘 공공데이터): Overview of the public facilities and local disposal information covered, grouped as outings (나들이 갈 때), public places (공공 시설 갈 때), sports (운동하러 갈 때) and disposal (버릴 때). With a region, the same grouping for that region: which kinds exist there and how many places, with the region page URL. Results are in Korean.

region.description: Optional Korean region name: 시도 (서울, 경기, 부산) or 시군구 (강남구, 수원시, 분당). 지역.
